pages.text: Labels let you give a Tobacco Box—and products drawn from it—a custom brand name. First craft blank Labels, then rename one in an Anvil to the name you want.

pages.title: Blank Labels
pages.text: Two Paper arranged diagonally make 2 Labels.

Craft a $(thing)Tobacco Box + named Label$() to apply that label to the box. A labeled box will only accept incoming products whose product label matches the box; an unlabeled product cannot be mixed into a labeled batch.
pages.title: Applying a Label

pages.text: When an item is extracted from a labeled box, the product inherits the box label. This lets a box act like branded packaging for cigars, cigarettes, shisha, or loose tobacco.
pages.title: Branded Products

pages.text: To duplicate a named label, craft exactly $(item)1 named Label + 1 blank Label$(). The result is two copies carrying the same name. This is a special recipe, so the layout is shapeless.
pages.title: Duplicating Labels
